parameters.command:
set -eu; SERVER=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || printf 'unknown'); DATABASE='YOUR_DATABASE'; CONTAINER='YOUR_POSTGRES_CONTAINER'; BUCKET='YOUR_S3_BUCKET'; START=$(date +%s); STAMP=$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S); DATE_PATH=$(date +%Y/%m/%d); FILE="database_${STAMP}.sql.gz"; TMP="/tmp/${FILE}"; trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT; if docker exec "$CONTAINER" pg_dump -U 'YOUR_POSTGRES_USER' "$DATABASE" | gzip > "$TMP" && test -s "$TMP" && aws s3 cp "$TMP" "s3://${BUCKET}/postgres/${SERVER}/${DATE_PATH}/${FILE}" --only-show-errors; then SIZE=$(du -h "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}'); DURATION=$(( $(date +%s) - START )); printf 'STATUS=SUCCESS
SERVER=%s
DATABASE=%s
BACKUP_FILE=%s
BACKUP_SIZE=%s
S3_PATH=s3://%s/postgres/%s/%s/%s
DURATION=%ss
' "$SERVER" "$DATABASE" "$FILE" "$SIZE" "$BUCKET" "$SERVER" "$DATE_PATH" "$FILE" "$DURATION"; else code=$?; printf 'STATUS=FAILED
SERVER=%s
DATABASE=%s
ERROR=Backup command failed with exit code %s
' "$SERVER" "$DATABASE" "$code"; exit "$code"; fi
